raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation Kimi-K3 has 69 KDA (Kimi Delta Attention) layers. On MI350X / MI355X (gfx950), KDA prefill runs the multi-kernel Triton `chunk_kda` pipeline. This PR adds a HIP chunked-prefill kernel for gfx950 and tries it first inside `TritonKDAKernel.extend`, so the default prefill backend gets faster on gfx950 without a new flag. Other GPUs, and inputs the kernel does not cover, keep `chunk_kda`. **Note: This kernel is generated by [KDAgent](https://nvlabs.github.io/kda/blog/2026-09-27-kda-for-kda/) in AMD ecosystems. Cost around 5k dollars in humanize2 flow to get this.** ## Modifications The kernel follows the `sglang.kernels` layout of RFC #29630: it was produced with the Kernel Design Agents workflow, so the implementation lives in `kernels/kda_kernels`, it is registered with `KernelBackend.KDA`, and runtime code reaches it only through the `sglang.kernels.ops` facade. - `kernels/kda_kernels/csrc/attention/kda_prefill_gfx950.cu` and its loader `kernels/kda_kernels/kda_prefill_gfx950.py`, JIT-compiled on first use with `load_extension_with_recovery`. The kernel needs the bf16 16x16x32 MFMA and up to 157 KiB of LDS, so it is gfx950-only. - `kda_intra_kernel` runs over (64-token chunk, head). It computes the gate `-5 * sigmoid(exp(A_log) * (g + dt_bias))` and its chunk cumsum, the beta sigmoid, the q/k L2 norms, and the chunk's UT transform and intra-chunk attention, and stores them as one workspace block per chunk. - A recurrence kernel walks each sequence's chunks and writes the outputs, the final states (in place, like `chunk_kda`) and the optional `track_state` snapshot. `kda_recur_path` picks one of six layouts from the batch shape, the longest sequence and the CU count: a pipelined single kernel for balanced batches with about one (sequence, head) pair per CU, sequence groups joined by an fp32 scan for one long sequence, warp-specialized value-split kernels for few pairs or a dominant long sequence, and one workgroup per pair otherwise. - `kernels/kda_kernels/README.md`: provenance entry. - `kernels/ops/attention/__init__.py`: registers `attention.kda_prefill_gfx950` (`KernelBackend.KDA`, HIP). - `kernels/ops/attention/linear/kda_gfx950_prefill.py` (facade): `extend()` calls the kernel through `get_kernel` and returns `None` for anything it does not cover: other GPUs, `SGLANG_ROCM_KDA_HIP_PREFILL=0`, spec-decode extends, prefill CUDA graph chunk tables, a gate lower bound other than -5, non-raw beta, per-chunk states `h` requested without a track buffer, non-bf16 inputs, head dim other than 128, and a non-contiguous state pool. It passes `max(extend_seq_lens_cpu)` to the kernel, so choosing the layout needs no GPU sync. - `srt/layers/attention/linear/kernels/kda_triton.py`: on ROCm, `TritonKDAKernel.extend` calls the facade first and keeps `chunk_kda` when it returns `None`. This guarded call is the only runtime change; CUDA builds never import the facade. - `test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_kda_gfx950_prefill.py` (MI35x suite): the Triton extend routes to the HIP kernel; uncovered inputs fall back; eight layouts covering all six recurrence paths, the chunk-aligned track extend and five track-snapshot cases match `chunk_kda`; untouched state slots stay bit-identical. ## Accuracy Tests MI355X, `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261020`. - Against `chunk_kda` over 210 shapes (1-128 sequences of 64-64K tokens, 12 and 24 heads, with and without `track_state`): output, final-state and track-snapshot relative L2 difference at most 0.59% (both kernels round to bf16). Unselected state slots stay bit-identical. - Pass: the new test, `unit/kernels/test_kernels_namespace.py` (includes the KDA directory/backend pairing check), `attention/unittests/kda/test_triton.py`, `attention/test_kda_kernels.py`, `kernels/ops/attention/test_fused_kda_conv_recurrent_verify.py`, `kernels/ops/attention/kda_flydsl/test_kimi_k3_kda_decode.py` and `amd/test_kimi_k3_kda_inproj_fusion.py`. - Kimi-K3 TP8 GSM8K (8-shot, 1319 questions): 0.960 with both HIP kernels off, 0.961 with this PR and the companion fused-decode PR on. ## Speed Tests and Profiling **Kernel.** Median of 20 calls after 3 warmups, `chunk_kda` through `TritonKDAKernel.extend` versus the HIP kernel, MI355X: | Sequences (tokens) | Heads | track_state | Path | Triton | HIP | Speedup | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 x 64 | 12 | no | fused | 0.189 ms | 0.018 ms | 10.71x | | 1 x 1024 | 12 | no | ws4 | 0.205 ms | 0.047 ms | 4.34x | | 1 x 4096 | 12 | no | grp | 0.364 ms | 0.093 ms | 3.90x | | 1 x 16384 | 12 | no | grp | 0.957 ms | 0.262 ms | 3.66x | | 1 x 65536 | 12 | no | grp | 3.928 ms | 0.907 ms | 4.33x | | 8 x 1024 | 12 | no | ws2 | 0.321 ms | 0.093 ms | 3.46x | | 16 x 1024 | 12 | no | fused | 0.501 ms | 0.157 ms | 3.19x | | 64 x 256 | 12 | no | fused | 0.507 ms | 0.152 ms | 3.33x | | 128 x 128 | 12 | no | fused | 0.528 ms | 0.167 ms | 3.17x | | 8192 + 16 x 128 | 12 | no | ws4 | 0.571 ms | 0.273 ms | 2.09x | | 17 + 4096 + 333 + 8000 | 12 | no | ws4 | 0.600 ms | 0.280 ms | 2.14x | | 1 x 8192 | 12 | yes | grp | 0.545 ms | 0.146 ms | 3.72x | | 1 x 16384 | 12 | yes | grp | 0.974 ms | 0.263 ms | 3.71x | | 8 x 1024 | 12 | yes | vs2 | 0.331 ms | 0.095 ms | 3.49x | | 64 x 256 | 12 | yes | vs1 | 0.522 ms | 0.228 ms | 2.29x | Over all 210 shapes: 2.06x-11.11x, geomean 4.08x (one sequence 4.56x, equal-length batches 4.27x, mixed-length batches 2.98x, with `track_state` 2.91x; 12 heads 4.21x, 24 heads 3.94x). The chosen layout is within 0.3% (geomean) of the fastest of the six layouts forced one at a time. **The model runs the kernel.** Kimi-K3 TP8, rank-0 GPU profile (`/start_profile`) of one 10,244-token request with 8 output tokens: | Kernels (calls) | Baseline | This PR + fused decode PR | |---|---|---| | KDA prefill | `chunk_kda`: `l2norm_fwd` (138), `kda_gate_chunk_cumsum` (69), `chunk_kda_fwd_kernel_intra_sub_chunk`, `chunk_kda_fwd_kernel_inter_solve_fused` and `recompute_w_u_fwd` (thousands of calls, because the first request at this length triggers Triton autotuning), `chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd_kernel_h` (69), `chunk_gla_fwd_kernel_o` (69) | `kda_intra_kernel` (69), `kda_recur_grp_vs1` (138, two passes), `kda_recur_grp_scan` (69); no Triton `chunk_kda` kernel | **Kimi-K3 TP8 E2E.** Measured with this PR and the companion fused-decode PR applied; the baseline sets `SGLANG_ROCM_KDA_HIP_PREFILL=0 SGLANG_ROCM_K3_KDA_FUSED_BACKEND=none`, which is the current `main` behavior. Baseline and candidate servers were launched alternately, two rounds each; the tables show the mean of the two rounds. The default extra-buffer radix cache passes `track_state` on every extend. ```bash SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT=1 AITER_FLYDSL_FORCE=1 AITER_SITUV2_A8W4=1 \ python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --tp-size 8 \ --attention-backend triton --dtype bfloat16 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \ --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 --max-running-requests 64 \ --reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --tool-call-parser kimi_k3 --trust-remote-code python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random-ids \ --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 512 --random-range-ratio 1 \ --num-prompts 80 --max-concurrency 16 --warmup-requests 16 --flush-cache --seed 42 # also: --num-prompts 320 --max-concurrency 64; and --random-input-len 8192 # --random-output-len 64 --num-prompts 40 --max-concurrency 8 --warmup-requests 8 ``` Single-request TTFT isolates prefill: streamed `/v1/completions` with `max_tokens=1`, each prompt unique from its first token so the radix cache cannot reuse it, median of 5 after 2 warmups per round. | Prompt tokens | Baseline | This PR | Change | |---|---|---|---| | 1,006 | 156.5 ms | 137.9 ms | -11.9% | | 4,006 | 218.1 ms | 209.9 ms | -3.8% | | 10,246 | 421.7 ms | 406.3 ms | -3.6% | | 32,006 | 1718.3 ms | 1658.1 ms | -3.5% | Online serving (`bench_serving`). TTFT under load also includes time spent behind other requests' decode steps, so these rows reflect both PRs: | Workload | Metric | Baseline | Both PRs | Change | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1024 in / 512 out, concurrency 16 | median TTFT | 1028.7 ms | 987.1 ms | -4.0% | | | median TPOT | 23.7 ms | 22.9 ms | -3.6% | | | output throughput | 617.7 tok/s | 642.7 tok/s | +4.1% | | 1024 in / 512 out, concurrency 64 | median TTFT | 3841.7 ms | 3695.7 ms | -3.8% | | | median TPOT | 33.5 ms | 32.4 ms | -3.2% | | | output throughput | 1536.7 tok/s | 1590.1 tok/s | +3.5% | | 8192 in / 64 out, concurrency 8 | median TTFT | 3866.4 ms | 3771.8 ms | -2.4% | | | median TPOT | 20.2 ms | 19.5 ms | -3.8% | | | output throughput | 99.5 tok/s | 102.4 tok/s | +3.0% | The two rounds of each server differed by at most 0.6% in output throughput.
Batch prefill TTFT with bench_one_batch_server `last_ttft` of `python3 -m sglang.bench_one_batch_server --model None --base-url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --batch-size 1 8 32 64 --input-len 1024 --output-len 512 --dataset-name random-ids` (and `--batch-size 4 16 --input-len 4096 --output-len 16`), median of 2 runs: | Requests x tokens | Baseline | This PR | Change | |---|---|---|---| | 1 x 1024 | 168.9 ms | 145.5 ms | -13.9% | | 8 x 1024 | 451.0 ms | 440.1 ms | -2.4% | | 32 x 1024 | 1698.5 ms | 1647.4 ms | -3.0% | | 64 x 1024 | 3409.6 ms | 3306.8 ms | -3.0% | | 4 x 4096 | 859.6 ms | 845.5 ms | -1.6% | | 16 x 4096 | 3432.3 ms | 3335.4 ms | -2.8% |
The Kimi-K3 cookbook's MI355X recipe (DCP8, AITER attention, fp8 KV cache) failed to allocate the KDA state cache on this image for both variants, so these runs use Triton attention without DCP. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (isort, ruff, ruff-format, codespell, clang-format) - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (`kda_kernels/README.md` provenance entry; no new flags, `SGLANG_ROCM_KDA_HIP_PREFILL=0` is described in the facade docstring.) - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #39713403212](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39713403212) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #39713403296](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39713403296) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #39713403054](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39713403054)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""HIP Kimi Delta Attention chunked prefill for gfx950 (MI350X / MI355X).
+
+The extension is JIT-compiled with ``torch.utils.cpp_extension`` on first use
+and cached under ``TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.kda_kernels import _cuda_source
+
+_ext = None
+
+
+def _load():
+    global _ext
+    if _ext is None:
+        from sglang.srt.utils.cpp_extension_loader import (
+            load_extension_with_recovery,
+        )
+
+        # torch's JIT builds for every arch in PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH
+        previous_arch = os.environ.get("PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH")
+        os.environ["PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH"] = "gfx950"
+        try:
+            _ext = load_extension_with_recovery(
+                name="kda_prefill_gfx950",
+                sources=[_cuda_source("attention/kda_prefill_gfx950.cu")],
+                extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3", "-mllvm", "-amdgpu-mfma-vgpr-form"],
+                extra_cflags=["-O3"],
+            )
+        finally:
+            if previous_arch is None:
+                os.environ.pop("PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH", None)
+            else:
+                os.environ["PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH"] = previous_arch
+    return _ext
+
+
+def kda_prefill_gfx950(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    g: torch.Tensor,
+    beta: torch.Tensor,
+    A_log: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    max_seqlen: int,
+    scale: float,
+    track_state: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    track_chunk_idx: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Returns the output; ssm_states[cache_indices] is updated in place."""
+    empty = q.new_empty(0, dtype=torch.float32)
+    return _load().kda_prefill_gfx950(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        g,
+        beta,
+        A_log,
+        dt_bias,
+        ssm_states,
+        cache_indices,
+        cu_seqlens,
+        max_seqlen,
+        empty if track_state is None else track_state,
+        empty.long() if track_chunk_idx is None else track_chunk_idx,
+        scale,
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = ["kda_prefill_gfx950"]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""HIP Kimi Delta Attention chunked prefill for gfx950 (MI350X / MI355X).
+
+``TritonKDAKernel.extend`` tries :func:`extend` first on ROCm. It returns None for
+anything the kernel does not cover, and the caller keeps the Triton ``chunk_kda``
+path. On by default on gfx950; ``SGLANG_ROCM_KDA_HIP_PREFILL=0`` turns it off.
+
+The kernel is ``attention.kda_prefill_gfx950`` (``KernelBackend.KDA``), implemented
+in ``sglang.kernels.kda_kernels.kda_prefill_gfx950``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.selector import get_kernel
+from sglang.kernels.spec import KernelBackend
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def available() -> bool:
+    """gfx950 only: the kernel uses the 16x16x32 bf16 MFMA and up to 157 KiB of LDS."""
+    if os.environ.get("SGLANG_ROCM_KDA_HIP_PREFILL", "1").lower() in ("0", "false"):
+        return False
+    if not torch.version.hip or not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return False
+    return torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).gcnArchName.split(":")[0] == "gfx950"
+
+
+def extend(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    g: torch.Tensor,
+    beta: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+    A_log: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    lower_bound: float | None = None,
+    beta_is_raw: bool = False,
+    return_intermediate_states: bool = False,
+    **kwargs,
+):
+    """``TritonKDAKernel.extend`` on the HIP kernel, or None when it is not covered.
+
+    The kernel applies the gate (A_log, dt_bias, lower bound -5), the beta sigmoid
+    and the q / k L2 norms itself, reads and overwrites ``ssm_states`` at
+    ``cache_indices`` in place, and writes the optional fp32 ``track_state``
+    snapshot. It cannot return the per-chunk states ``h``.
+    """
+    track_state = kwargs.get("track_state")
+    track_chunk_idx = kwargs.get("track_chunk_idx")
+    track_ssm_h_src = kwargs.get("track_ssm_h_src")
+    if not (
+        available()
+        # spec-decode extends stay on the reference path
+        and not kwargs.get("is_spec_decode", False)
+        # breakable prefill CUDA graphs pass padded chunk tables
+        and kwargs.get("chunk_indices") is None
+        and (track_state is None) == (track_chunk_idx is None)
+        # aligned-only tracking reads the final state, so h is not needed
+        and not (
+            return_intermediate_states
+            and track_state is None
+            and (track_ssm_h_src is None or track_ssm_h_src.numel() > 0)
+        )
+        and lower_bound == -5.0
+        and beta_is_raw
+        and A_log is not None
+        and dt_bias is not None
+        and all(x.dtype == torch.bfloat16 for x in (q, k, v, g, beta))
+        and ssm_states.dtype == torch.float32
+        and ssm_states.is_contiguous()
+        and q.shape == k.shape == v.shape == g.shape
+        and q.ndim == 4
+        and q.shape[0] == 1
+        and q.shape[-1] == 128
+        and ssm_states.shape[-2:] == (128, 128)
+    ):
+        return None
+    # the launch layout depends on the longest sequence; T bounds it without a sync
+    seq_lens = kwargs.get("extend_seq_lens_cpu")
+    output = get_kernel("attention.kda_prefill_gfx950", KernelBackend.KDA)(
+        q.contiguous(),
+        k.contiguous(),
+        v.contiguous(),
+        g.contiguous(),
+        beta.contiguous(),
+        A_log.reshape(-1).float().contiguous(),
+        dt_bias.reshape(-1).float().contiguous(),
+        ssm_states,
+        cache_indices.to(torch.int32).contiguous(),
+        query_start_loc.to(torch.int32).contiguous(),
+        max(seq_lens) if seq_lens else q.shape[1],
+        q.shape[-1] ** -0.5,
+        track_state=track_state,
+        track_chunk_idx=(
+            None
+            if track_chunk_idx is None
+            else track_chunk_idx.to(torch.int64).contiguous()
+        ),
+    )
+    return (output, None) if return_intermediate_states else output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+import itertools
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.fla.kda import chunk_kda
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.linear import kda_gfx950_prefill
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.kernels import kda_triton
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=300, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+SLOTS = 40
+
+
+def _is_gfx950() -> bool:
+    return bool(
+        torch.version.hip
+        and torch.cuda.is_available()
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_properties().gcnArchName.split(":", 1)[0] == "gfx950"
+    )
+
+
+def _inputs(lengths, heads=4, seed=42) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    shape = (1, sum(lengths), heads, 128)
+
+    def randn(shape, dtype, scale):
+        return (torch.randn(shape, generator=generator, device="cuda") * scale).to(
+            dtype
+        )
+
+    return {
+        "q": randn(shape, torch.bfloat16, 0.5),
+        "k": randn(shape, torch.bfloat16, 0.5),
+        "v": randn(shape, torch.bfloat16, 0.5),
+        "g": randn(shape, torch.bfloat16, 0.5),
+        "beta": randn(shape[:3], torch.bfloat16, 0.5),
+        "A_log": torch.randn(heads, generator=generator, device="cuda"),
+        "dt_bias": torch.randn(heads * 128, generator=generator, device="cuda"),
+        "ssm_states": randn((SLOTS, heads, 128, 128), torch.float32, 0.1),
+        "cache_indices": torch.randperm(SLOTS, generator=generator, device="cuda")[
+            : len(lengths)
+        ].to(torch.int32),
+        "query_start_loc": torch.tensor(
+            (0, *itertools.accumulate(lengths)), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def _clone(inputs):
+    return {name: value.clone() for name, value in inputs.items()}
+
+
+def _args(inputs):
+    return (inputs[name] for name in ("q", "k", "v", "g", "beta"))
+
+
+def _reference(inputs, **track):
+    return chunk_kda(
+        *_args(inputs),
+        initial_state=inputs["ssm_states"],
+        initial_state_indices=inputs["cache_indices"],
+        use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True,
+        cu_seqlens=inputs["query_start_loc"],
+        A_log=inputs["A_log"],
+        dt_bias=inputs["dt_bias"],
+        lower_bound=-5.0,
+        beta_is_raw=True,
+        output_intermediate_states=bool(track),
+        **track,
+    )
+
+
+def _hip(inputs, lower_bound=-5.0, **kwargs):
+    return kda_gfx950_prefill.extend(
+        *_args(inputs),
+        ssm_states=inputs["ssm_states"],
+        cache_indices=inputs["cache_indices"],
+        query_start_loc=inputs["query_start_loc"],
+        A_log=inputs["A_log"],
+        dt_bias=inputs["dt_bias"],
+        lower_bound=lower_bound,
+        beta_is_raw=True,
+        return_intermediate_states="track_state" in kwargs
+        or "track_ssm_h_src" in kwargs,
+        extend_seq_lens_cpu=inputs["query_start_loc"].diff().tolist(),
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(_is_gfx950(), "gfx950 KDA prefill requires MI35x")
+class TestGfx950KDAPrefill(CustomTestCase):
+    def _assert_close(self, actual, expected, inputs, actual_inputs, expected_inputs):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            actual.float(), expected.float(), rtol=2e-2, atol=3e-2
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            actual_inputs["ssm_states"],
+            expected_inputs["ssm_states"],
+            rtol=2e-2,
+            atol=3e-2,
+        )
+        selected = torch.zeros(SLOTS, dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda")
+        selected[inputs["cache_indices"].long()] = True
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.equal(
+                actual_inputs["ssm_states"][~selected], inputs["ssm_states"][~selected]
+            )
+        )
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_triton_extend_runs_the_hip_kernel(self):
+        inputs = _inputs((193, 137))
+        with patch.object(
+            kda_triton,
+            "chunk_kda",
+            side_effect=AssertionError("unexpected fallback to Triton chunk_kda"),
+        ):
+            result = kda_triton.TritonKDAKernel().extend(
+                *_args(inputs),
+                ssm_states=inputs["ssm_states"],
+                cache_indices=inputs["cache_indices"],
+                query_start_loc=inputs["query_start_loc"],
+                A_log=inputs["A_log"],
+                dt_bias=inputs["dt_bias"],
+                lower_bound=-5.0,
+                beta_is_raw=True,
+            )
+        self.assertIsInstance(result, torch.Tensor)
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_uncovered_inputs_fall_back(self):
+        inputs = _inputs((193, 137))
+        self.assertIsNone(_hip(inputs, lower_bound=None))
+        self.assertIsNone(_hip(inputs, is_spec_decode=True))
+        self.assertIsNone(_hip(inputs, chunk_indices=torch.zeros(1, 2, device="cuda")))
+        # unaligned tracking without a snapshot buffer needs the per-chunk h
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            _hip(inputs, track_ssm_h_src=torch.ones(1, device="cuda").long())
+        )
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_layouts_match_triton(self):
+        # every recurrence path of kda_recur_path on a 256-CU MI35x
+        for lengths, heads in (
+            ((40, 63, 1), 12),  # fused: sequences of one chunk
+            ((1024,) * 16, 12),  # fused: balanced, 3/4 pair per CU
+            ((8192,), 12),  # grp: one long sequence
+            ((300, 300), 4),  # ws4: few pairs
+            ((4096,) * 4, 12),  # ws4
+            ((17, 4096, 333, 8000), 12),  # ws4: a dominant long sequence
+            ((2048,) * 8, 12),  # ws2
+            ((1024,) * 12, 12),  # vs1
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(lengths=lengths[:4], sequences=len(lengths), heads=heads):
+                inputs = _inputs(lengths, heads)
+                actual_inputs, expected_inputs = _clone(inputs), _clone(inputs)
+                expected = _reference(expected_inputs)
+                actual = _hip(actual_inputs)
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                self._assert_close(
+                    actual, expected, inputs, actual_inputs, expected_inputs
+                )
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_aligned_track_extend_skips_snapshot(self):
+        inputs = _inputs((193, 137))
+        actual_inputs, expected_inputs = _clone(inputs), _clone(inputs)
+        expected = _reference(expected_inputs, track_state=None, track_chunk_idx=None)
+        actual, h = _hip(
+            actual_inputs, track_ssm_h_src=torch.empty(0, device="cuda").long()
+        )
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        self.assertIsNone(h)
+        self._assert_close(actual, expected[0], inputs, actual_inputs, expected_inputs)
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_track_snapshots_match_triton(self):
+        # chunk 3 lies in the first sequence group of the 4000-token walk, chunk
+        # 40 in a later one
+        for lengths, chunks, heads in (
+            ((193, 137), (2, 1), 4),  # vs2
+            ((4000,), (3,), 4),  # grp
+            ((4000,), (40,), 4),  # grp
+            ((1024,) * 8, (5,) * 8, 12),  # vs2
+            ((256,) * 24, (1,) * 24, 12),  # vs1
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(lengths=lengths[:4], chunks=chunks[:4], heads=heads):
+                inputs = _inputs(lengths, heads)
+                actual_inputs, expected_inputs = _clone(inputs), _clone(inputs)
+                track_chunk_idx = torch.tensor(chunks, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64)
+                expected_track = torch.zeros(
+                    len(lengths), heads, 128, 128, device="cuda"
+                )
+                actual_track = torch.zeros_like(expected_track)
+                expected = _reference(
+                    expected_inputs,
+                    track_state=expected_track,
+                    track_chunk_idx=track_chunk_idx,
+                )
+                actual, h = _hip(
+                    actual_inputs,
+                    track_state=actual_track,
+                    track_chunk_idx=track_chunk_idx,
+                )
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                self.assertIsNone(h)
+                self._assert_close(
+                    actual, expected[0], inputs, actual_inputs, expected_inputs
+                )
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    actual_track, expected_track, rtol=2e-2, atol=3e-2
+                )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
